summary: Board-certified primary care physician with 9 years of continuous full-time experience delivering comprehensive care in high-volume outpatient settings. Recognized for evidence-based chronic disease management, preventive care, and collaborative leadership of multidisciplinary clinical teams.

experience.title: Physician (Primary Care)
bullets: Provide comprehensive primary care to a panel of approximately 2,100 patients, prescribing medications, vaccinations, and targeted therapies for acute and chronic conditions.

Ordered, performed, and interpreted diagnostic tests, imaging, and laboratory panels to diagnose conditions and adjust treatment plans, improving hypertension and diabetes control rates by 18% year over year.
Documented medical histories, examination results, and treatment progress in the electronic health record while maintaining compliance with quality and regulatory standards.
Directed and coordinated care activities of nurses, medical assistants, and care coordinators, leading daily huddle reviews that reduced avoidable emergency department visits by 12%.
Counseled patients on diet, activity, hygiene, and disease prevention, and referred complex cases to specialists with timely follow-up to ensure continuity of care.

experience.title: Physician (Primary Care)
bullets: Managed a diverse outpatient panel across all age groups, delivering preventive screenings, immunizations, and same-day acute care visits averaging 22 patients per day.
Monitored patient conditions and reevaluated treatments at follow-up intervals, reducing hospital readmissions among attributed patients by 15%.
Interpreted test results and discussed diagnoses and treatment options with patients and caregivers, earning consistently high patient satisfaction scores.
Supervised and mentored nursing staff, residents, and students during clinical rotations, supporting skill development in history-taking and evidence-based prescribing.
Collaborated with behavioral health and pharmacy teams to implement medication reconciliation and chronic care outreach programs.

experience.title: Primary Care Physician
bullets: Delivered full-spectrum primary care services, including preventive care, chronic disease management, and minor procedures for a growing patient panel.
Collected and maintained detailed patient histories, reports, and examination findings to support accurate diagnosis and longitudinal care planning.
Prescribed and administered vaccines and therapies in accordance with clinical guidelines, achieving above-target immunization rates for pediatric and adult populations.
Advised community members on lifestyle, nutrition, and disease prevention through health education sessions and individual counseling.
Referred patients to medical specialists and coordinated multidisciplinary care for complex or high-risk cases.

experience.title: Resident Physician, Primary Care
experience.employer: a teaching hospital and affiliated clinics
bullets: Completed supervised clinical training in outpatient and inpatient settings, performing histories, examinations, and diagnostic workups under attending oversight.
Prescribed treatments and medications and monitored patient progress across continuity clinics and hospital rotations.
Ordered and interpreted laboratory and imaging studies, presenting findings during rounds and adjusting care plans accordingly.
Participated in quality improvement initiatives focused on preventive screening and patient education.

education.institution: a state university school of medicine
